# pi-web-access upstream source

`upstream/` is an unmodified export of Nico Bailon's `pi-web-access` at
commit `692483ae782e41978fb2eba0eec70fd4056608c8` (version `0.19.0`). The exact
Git tree is `6497a48cddac5052061d67563566c917fc58e6ed`.

The upstream project is MIT licensed. `LICENSE` and every upstream attribution
are preserved verbatim. This source record is not used by the
`buzzard-agent-web` UI/server package and is retained only for a possible
independent web-research capability. The vendored source is not renamed or
debranded.
